pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/98768

~~DO NOT MERGE, fix below issues first!~~

Add a test that iteratively generates random queries starting from test indexes (CSV tests).
It's just string manipulation to create syntactically valid queries, no semantics at all (hence no validation of the results).
The intention is to test errors and corner cases in query planning and layout management, plus to spot wrongly managed exceptions.

Tests disabled by default, because there are still some known issues in the query planner that trigger failures.

Problems found: 

- [x] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/102061
- [x] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/102084
- [x] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/102083
- [x] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/102120
- [x] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/102121
- [x] https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/102123
pr_title: ES|QL: Add random test query generator
